title: Chosen-Key Differential Characteristics for 9- and 10-Round AES-128
summary: The reported search found no ten-round AES characteristic with at most 21 active state S-boxes; chosen-key differential characteristics for nine and ten rounds remain to be constructed.

formal_statement.body: Construct chosen-key differential characteristics for both nine-round and ten-round $\mathrm{AES\text{-}128}$.

parameters: Round count: nine and ten rounds are the two target instances
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct chosen-key differential characteristics for both target round counts.

citations.label: Automatic Search for Related-Key Differential Characteristics in Byte-Oriented Block Ciphers: Application to AES, Camellia, Khazad and Others

progress.summary: The conclusion explicitly presents producing chosen-key differential characteristics for nine and ten rounds of AES-128 as an open problem. The paper reports finding no ten-round AES characteristic with at most 21 active state S-boxes.
citation_labels: Alex Biryukov et al., Automatic Search for Related-Key Differential Characteristics in Byte-Oriented Block Ciphers: Application to AES, Camellia, Khazad and Others
